title: 12-inch subwoofer, flat open baffle
text: Hornresp: CH, S1 = S2 = S5 = S6 = 2025 cm², L12 = L56 = 0.1 cm (its flat baffle), Vrc = Vtc = 0, Ang = 2π; its path is 0.862·√S = 38.8 cm. App: the 45 × 45 cm square board of that area, centred driver, no thickness; its own path D comes from edge diffraction (29.4 cm with this cone), so the bass differs by 20·log(D ratio).
